title: ci: gate Jenkins deployment on Selenium
head: feature/jenkins-selenium-gate

reviews.author: kirti-vispute
reviews.body:
### Task 10 assisted self-review

Reviewed the exact PR head and the two implementation commits. This is a single-owner COMMENT self-review assisted by Codex; no independent approval is claimed.

- The temporary test app serves the newly packaged JAR on 127.0.0.1:8091, uses an isolated workspace database and verifies readiness/PID ownership. Pipeline cleanup stops only its recorded process.
- The Selenium command returns failure to Jenkins; its `post` section still publishes XML, HTML and screenshots. The failed build's console explicitly skipped Deploy, and the old live PID/source/hash remained unchanged and healthy.
- The deliberate wrong registration assertion is visible in commit 67b5d20. Jenkins #4 failed for that exact expected-versus-actual value, with four other Selenium cases passing. Commit 8ff53a5 restored the real assertion; Jenkins #5 passed 34 backend and five browser tests and deployed.
- The successful archived and live JAR SHA matched. Pipeline syntax passed Jenkins validation. The approved MVP application source is unchanged.
- The guide distinguishes failed/successful evidence and keeps Task 11 Docker work pending.

No blocking issue found for the Task 10 scope. Final merge-source verification will be captured after this PR lands on develop.
